At its core, this solution is about infrastructure sovereignty, where creators own and control their digital commerce stacks, free from the constraints of third-party payment processors. This means deploying a custom-built, end-to-end digital store, using tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Sites for hosting, and integrating cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. By doing so, creators can avoid platform fees, maintain full control over their digital assets, and expand their customer base by accepting cryptocurrency payments.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind this solution involves a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Google Sites, Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, Supabase, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. These tools work together to create a seamless digital store experience, where customers can browse, purchase, and download digital products, like music, instantly. By leveraging these tools, creators can automate delivery, manage orders, and store customer data, all within a fully custom-built digital commerce stack.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators who want to sell their products online without relying on Stripe or other payment platforms. It's ideal for creators in countries where these platforms are blocked or restricted, like Zimbabwe, as well as those who want to reduce fees associated with traditional payment processing. By using this solution, creators can expand their customer base, increase revenue, and maintain full control over their digital assets.

The key components of this solution include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain cryptocurrency payment verification. By integrating these components, creators can create a fully custom-built digital store that meets their specific needs and requirements.
